name: Namdroling Monastery (Golden Temple)
description: Namdroling Monastery (Thegchog Namdrol Shedrub Dargyeling), popularly known as the Golden Temple, was founded in 1963 by His Holiness the 3rd Penor Rinpoche. It is one of the largest teaching centers of the Nyingma lineage in the world, home to over 4,000 monks and nuns.
key_features: Three 40-foot gilded copper statues of Buddha Shakyamuni, Guru Padmasambhava, and Buddha Amitayus
Vibrant multi-story hand-painted murals depicting the Twelve Deeds of Buddha and peaceful/wrathful deities
Ngagyur Nyingma Institute (higher Buddhist philosophy shedra university)
Gilded roof pinnacles and Golden Wheel of Dharma (Dharmachakra) flanked by two deer

faqs.a: Namdroling was established in 1963 by His Holiness Drubwang Padma Norbu Rinpoche (3rd Penor Rinpoche) with a small group of monks in the bamboo forests of Bylakuppe.

faqs.q: What are the three main statues inside the Golden Temple?
faqs.a: The sanctum houses three 40-foot gilded statues: Buddha Shakyamuni at the center, flanked by Guru Padmasambhava on the right and Buddha Amitayus on the left.

faqs.q: What is the Tibetan name for Namdroling Golden Temple?
faqs.a: The temple is formally named Padma Sambhava Buddhist Vihara, part of Thegchog Namdrol Shedrub Dargyeling.

name: Mount Emei (Golden Summit / Jinding)
description: The Golden Summit of Mount Emei sits at an altitude of 3,077 meters, one of the Four Sacred Buddhist Mountains of China. It is crowned by the monumental 48-meter multi-faced Golden Statue of Bodhisattva Samantabhadra above the sea of clouds.
key_features: 48-meter tall Golden Statue of Bodhisattva Samantabhadra with 10 faces seated on 4 white elephants
Golden Summit Main Temple Hall (Jinding) and Bronze Hall
Atmospheric Buddha's Light (halo/glory phenomenon) over the misty mountain valleys
Panoramic Sea of Clouds overlook terrace at 3,077m elevation

faqs.q: What is the height of the Golden Samantabhadra statue?
faqs.a: The statue stands 48 meters high, weighs 660 tons of bronze with gold gilding, and features 10 compassionate faces looking toward all ten directions of space.

faqs.q: What is Buddha's Light on Mount Emei?
faqs.a: Buddha's Light is a natural diffraction halo phenomenon where sunlight casts the viewer's shadow onto the sea of clouds surrounded by rainbow rings.

name: Rumtek Monastery (Dharma Chakra Centre)
description: Rumtek Monastery, also called the Dharma Chakra Centre, is the seat-in-exile of the Gyalwang Karmapa. Located 24 km from Gangtok, it is one of the largest and most significant monasteries in Sikkim, known for its golden stupa containing the relics of the 16th Karmapa.
key_features: Courtyard for annual Cham (sacred masked) dances

faqs.a: The original monastery was founded in the mid-1700s by Changchub Dorje, the 12th Karmapa. The current grand complex was rebuilt in 1966 by the 16th Karmapa, Rangjung Rigpe Dorje, after his exile from Tibet.

faqs.q: What is inside the Golden Stupa?
faqs.a: The 13-foot Golden Stupa houses the sacred bone relics, ashes, and ceremonial items of His Holiness the 16th Gyalwang Karmapa.
The most famous festival is the annual Kagyu Gutor Cham dance held on the 28th and 29th days of the 10th Tibetan month, performing sacred masked dances to dispel negative forces.

name: Pemayangtse Monastery
description: Pemayangtse ('Perfect Sublime Lotus') is one of the oldest premier monasteries in Sikkim, positioned atop a hill with views of Kangchenjunga. Only celibate monks of pure Tibetan lineage known as 'Ta-tshang' are admitted.
key_features: Seven-tiered wooden structure of Sangtokpalri (Heaven of Guru Rinpoche)
Pristine panoramic view of Mount Kangchenjunga
Starting point of the Rabdentse ruins trail

faqs.a: Sangtokpalri is a 7-tiered hand-carved wooden masterpiece built by Dungzin Rinpoche over 5 years, depicting the celestial paradise of Guru Padmasambhava with intricate bridges, rainbow towers, and celestial deities.

faqs.q: What is the meaning of the name Pemayangtse?
faqs.a: Pemayangtse translates to 'Perfect Sublime Lotus', symbolizing purity and spiritual awakening in Tibetan Buddhist philosophy.

name: Ringhim Monastery (Post-Earthquake Heritage Site)
description: Ringhim Monastery in Mangan was heavily damaged during the catastrophic 2011 Sikkim earthquake. MonasteryAI provides an Augmented Reality (AR) digital resurrection over the remaining foundation ruins to visualize its pre-disaster glory.
key_features: AR Digital Restoration of 2011 earthquake ruins
Historic prayer wheels dating to the 19th century
Ancient Choten (stupa) preserved by the local Lepcha and Bhutia community

faqs.q: What happened to Ringhim Monastery in 2011?
faqs.a: On September 18, 2011, a 6.9 magnitude earthquake struck Sikkim with its epicenter near Mangan. The original historic structure of Ringhim collapsed, leaving behind stone foundations now preserved digitally.
